title: Mara and the Contact
author: Orsen Ravensworth
blurb: Odile Voss, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
